STOPLIGHT.GREEN_SUBTITLE: All parameters are within safe ranges

HEALTH.PM2_5_YELLOW: Mild respiratory tract irritation and subtle reduction in lung function, especially in sensitive individuals (asthma, children, elderly)
HEALTH.PM2_5_ORANGE: Airway inflammation, aggravated asthma attacks, coughing, wheezing, and increased cardiovascular strain in vulnerable groups
HEALTH.PM2_5_RED: Aggravated asthma, respiratory inflammation, increased cardiovascular risk, potential lung damage with prolonged exposure
HEALTH.PM10_YELLOW: Upper respiratory tract irritation, mucous membrane dryness, and mild coughing in sensitive individuals
HEALTH.PM10_ORANGE: Bronchial irritation, increased airway resistance, exacerbation of asthma, and worsening bronchitis symptoms
HEALTH.PM10_RED: Upper airway irritation, bronchitis symptoms, reduced lung function
HEALTH.PM1_0_YELLOW: Early alveolar deposition causing mild cellular oxidative stress and subtle airway discomfort in susceptible individuals
HEALTH.PM1_0_ORANGE: Systemic oxidative stress, microvascular inflammation, increased cardiovascular strain, and worsening pulmonary conditions
HEALTH.PM1_0_RED: Deep lung penetration, particles enter bloodstream, systemic inflammation risk
HEALTH.CO2_YELLOW: Mild mental fatigue, reduced concentration, stuffiness, and subtle cognitive slowdown
HEALTH.CO2_ORANGE: Headaches, drowsiness, impaired cognitive performance, sluggish decision-making, and increased heart rate
HEALTH.CO2_RED: Drowsiness, headaches, impaired decision-making, dizziness — ventilate the area immediately
HEALTH.TEMP_HIGH_YELLOW: Thermal discomfort, mild dehydration risk, reduced alertness, and increased sweating
HEALTH.TEMP_LOW_YELLOW: Mild cold discomfort, peripheral vasoconstriction (reduced blood flow to extremities), and slight increase in blood pressure
HEALTH.TEMP_HIGH_ORANGE: Elevated cardiovascular strain, risk of heat cramps, heavy fatigue, and thermoregulatory stress in vulnerable populations
HEALTH.TEMP_LOW_ORANGE: Cold-induced airway constriction, elevated blood pressure, cardiovascular stress, and increased risk of bronchospasms
HEALTH.TEMP_HIGH_RED: Risk of heat exhaustion or heat stroke — unsafe for prolonged indoor activity
HEALTH.TEMP_LOW_RED: Risk of hypothermia — unsafe for prolonged exposure without heating
HEALTH.HUMIDITY_HIGH_YELLOW: Increased perspiration discomfort, dust mite proliferation, and mild allergy or sinus symptoms
HEALTH.HUMIDITY_LOW_YELLOW: Mild dryness of eyes, skin dryness, and mucous membrane irritation
HEALTH.HUMIDITY_HIGH_ORANGE: Accelerated mold and fungal spore growth, triggering allergic rhinitis, respiratory tract infections, and worsening asthma
HEALTH.HUMIDITY_LOW_ORANGE: Significant mucous membrane dehydration, impaired respiratory barrier, and heightened susceptibility to viral infections
HEALTH.HUMIDITY_HIGH_RED: Promotes mold growth and dust mites — respiratory and allergy risks
HEALTH.HUMIDITY_LOW_RED: Causes dry skin, eye irritation, and respiratory tract inflammation
